🎬 बॉलीवुड में बॉक्स ऑफिस क्लैश की खबरें तो आती रहती हैं, लेकिन भाईजान सलमान खान ने जो किया वो सबका दिल जीत रहा है!

4 December 2026 को सलमान खान की देशभक्ति ड्रामा Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace और श्रद्धा कपूर की बायोपिक Eetha एक ही दिन सिनेमाघरों में टकराने वाली हैं।

ABP News के एक इवेंट में सलमान खान ने खुलासा किया कि जब उनकी टीम ने 4 December की डेट तय की, तब उन्हें Eetha की रिलीज का बिल्कुल अंदाजा नहीं था। सलमान ने कहा कि उन्हें इस टकराव का वाकई बहुत बुरा लग रहा है और अगर पता होता तो वो इस डेट पर नहीं आते।

सलमान ने बताया कि उन्होंने तुरंत श्रद्धा कपूर को खुद फोन लगाया और माफी मांगी। सलमान के मुताबिक उन्होंने श्रद्धा को बचपन से बड़े होते देखा है।

इस पर श्रद्धा कपूर ने बेहद पॉजिटिव जवाब देते हुए कहा, 'नहीं सर, हम दोनों की फिल्मों के लिए बॉक्स ऑफिस पर पूरी जगह है।' सलमान ने श्रद्धा के प्रोजेक्ट को पूरा सपोर्ट किया और दर्शकों से Eetha देखने की अपील भी की। 🍿

ctx.text:
The two films are scheduled to release on December 4, 2026, with Salman revealing that he personally called Shraddha after learning about the scheduling overlap.
Salman Khan has addressed the upcoming box office clash between his film Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace and Shraddha Kapoor’s biopic Eetha , both scheduled to release in theatres on December 4, 2026. Speaking at a recent event with ABP News, the actor clarified that the simultaneous release was unintentional and revealed that he personally called Shraddha to apologise after learning that her film was arriving on the same date.
Explaining how the release dates coincided, Salman said that he was unaware of Eetha being scheduled for December 4 when his team finalised the date for Maatrubhumi . Expressing regret over the overlap, he said, “So, when we announced the 4th (of December), I did not know that Shraddha was coming out on the 4th of December. I feel really, really bad about it. If I would’ve known, I would not have come out with Shraddha."
The actor also spoke about his longstanding association with Shraddha and her family, explaining that he reached out to her directly once he became aware of the clash. Recalling their conversation, Salman shared, “I spoke to her. I called her up. I mean, I’ve seen them grow up. I spoke to her and said, ‘I’m really sorry, I didn’t know.'"
According to Salman, Shraddha responded positively and suggested that there was enough room for both films to release on the same day. Recounting her response, he said, “But she said, ‘No, no, sir. There’s enough space for both of our films to come’. So I told her, ‘Very good, I’m happy’". He also expressed support for her project, adding, “I do think that everyone should go and see that film."

The December 4 release date will see two films from different genres arrive in cinemas. Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace features Salman Khan alongside Chitrangada Singh in a patriotic drama combining emotional and action elements.
On the other hand, Eetha , directed by Laxman Utekar and backed by Maddock Films, stars Shraddha Kapoor as Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar, the legendary Tamasha and Lavani exponent. The film also features Randeep Hooda and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub.
With both projects currently scheduled for the same Friday, Salman’s comments have offered a glimpse into how the two actors have approached the release-date overlap. His public support for Eetha also reflects the cordial exchange between the two stars ahead of their respective films reaching theatres.
